name: Stanford Medicine Children's Health Teen Volunteer Program
org: Stanford Medicine Children's Health (Lucile Packard Children's Hospital)
what_you_do: You can volunteer as a teen in one of five areas: mother and baby care, play and recreation, support services, education, and community-based activities.
who_can_apply: Teens. Start with an online orientation, then a scheduled interview; eligible teens get the application link after the interview. Age and schedule rules are given in the orientation.
deadline_text: Openings and requirements are shown during the online orientation. No dates on the page.
how_to_apply: Start with the online orientation on volunteer.stanfordchildrens.org, then interview. Questions: volunteerservices@stanfordchildrens.org.
notes: Minimum age is not stated on the page. Ask the volunteer office.
